messages.content:
You are an expert JavaScript programmer. Write a single JavaScript function that implements a flight simulator with intentionally realistic aviation bugs.

REQUIREMENTS:
- Function takes a canvas ID parameter (canvas will be 500x500px)
- Renders 3D-perspective flight view with horizon, terrain, and HUD
- HUD displays: speed, altitude, heading, fuel
- Aircraft controls: throttle, pitch, roll, yaw
- Intentional realistic bugs: instrument lag during high G-forces, altimeter stickiness at certain altitudes, compass deviation near magnetic anomalies, engine power fluctuation during steep climbs
- Visual indicators when bugs affect instruments
- Smooth 60 FPS performance
- No external libraries, works in all major browsers
- Code must clearly document that bugs are intentional features

OUTPUT: Valid JavaScript code only. No explanatory text, comments outside code, or markdown formatting.

<script>
function runFlightSim(canvasId) {
/* This function creates a very simplified 3D flight simulator in a 500x500 canvas.
   It includes intentionally realistic bugs visible via visual indicators.
   All code is inside a single function. */
var canvas=document.getElementById(canvasId);
if(!canvas||canvas.width!==500||canvas.height!==500){
   alert("Canvas must exist and be 500x500px");
   return;
}
var ctx=canvas.getContext("2d");
var width=canvas.width, height=canvas.height;

// Key state
var keys={};
window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.code]=true;});
window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.code]=false;});

// Aircraft state
var aircraft={
   pos:{x:0,y:0,z:10000}, // start at 10,000 ft altitude
   vel:{x:0,y:0,z:0},
   pitch:0, // rad
   roll:0,  // rad
   yaw:0,   // rad
   throttle:0.5, // 0-1
   fuel:100, // percent
   enginePower:1 // effective throttle after bug
};

// Physics constants
var gravity=32.174; // ft/s^2
var maxSpeed=300; // knots
var dt=1/60; // simulation time step in seconds

// Instrument displays
var instruments={
   speed:0,
   alt:0,
   heading:0,
   fuel:100,
   // Lag buffers
   speedLag:0,
   altLag:0,
   headingLag:0,
   throttleLag:0,
   // Flags for bugs
   highG:false,
   altStick:false,
   compassError:false,
   engineFluct:false
};

// Functions to convert units
function knotsToFps(kts){ return kts*1.68781; }
function fpsToKnots(fps){ return fps/1.68781; }

// Simulation loop
function simulate(){
   // Update controls
   var accel=0;
   if(keys['ArrowUp']){ accel=0.02; } // increase throttle
   else if(keys['ArrowDown']){ accel=-0.02; }
   aircraft.throttle += accel;
   aircraft.throttle=Math.min(1,Math.max(0,aircraft.throttle));

   // Apply intentional engine fluctuation during steep climb (>30 degrees)
   if(Math.abs(aircraft.pitch)>0.5236){ // >30 deg
       if(Math.random()<0.1){ // 10% chance of fluctuation
          instruments.engineFluct=true;
          aircraft.enginePower = 0.8 + Math.random()*0.4; // 80-120%
       } else {
          instruments.engineFluct=false;
          aircraft.enginePower = 1;
       }
   } else {
      instruments.engineFluct=false;
      aircraft.enginePower = 1;
   }

   // Propulsion
   var thrust = aircraft.throttle*aircraft.enginePower*15000; // arbitrary thrust
   var direction = {
      x: Math.cos(aircraft.pitch)*Math.cos(aircraft.yaw),
      y: Math.sin(aircraft.pitch),
      z: Math.cos(aircraft.pitch)*Math.sin(aircraft.yaw)
   };
   // Update velocities
   aircraft.vel.x += (thrust*direction.x/aircraft.pos.z)*dt; // simplified scaling
   aircraft.vel.y += (thrust*direction.y/aircraft.pos.z)*dt;
   aircraft.vel.z += (thrust*direction.z/aircraft.pos.z)*dt;

   // Gravity
   aircraft.vel.y -= gravity*dt;

   // Wind (optional)
   // Update positions
   aircraft.pos.x += aircraft.vel.x*dt;
   aircraft.pos.y += aircraft.vel.y*dt;
   aircraft.pos.z += aircraft.vel.z*dt;

   // Fuel consumption
   aircraft.fuel -= (aircraft.throttle*0.05)*dt;
   aircraft.fuel = Math.max(0, aircraft.fuel);
   instruments.fuel = aircraft.fuel.toFixed(1);

   // Update attitude
   if(keys['KeyW']){ aircraft.pitch += 0.01; }
   if(keys['KeyS']){ aircraft.pitch -= 0.01; }
   if(keys['KeyA']){ aircraft.roll -= 0.01; }
   if(keys['KeyD']){ aircraft.roll += 0.01; }
   if(keys['KeyQ']){ aircraft.yaw -= 0.01; }
   if(keys['KeyE']){ aircraft.yaw += 0.01; }

   // Limit pitch/roll to realistic bounds
   aircraft.pitch = Math.max(-1.5,Math.min(1.5,aircraft.pitch));
   aircraft.roll = Math.max(-1.57,Math.min(1.57,aircraft.roll));

   // Instruments and bugs
   // Calculate true instruments
   var trueSpeed = fpsToKnots(Math.hypot(aircraft.vel.x,aircraft.vel.z));
   var trueAlt = aircraft.pos.y;
   var trueHeading = ( (aircraft.yaw*Math.PI*180/Math.PI) + 360 )%360; // degrees
   instruments.speed = trueSpeed.toFixed(0);
   instruments.alt = trueAlt.toFixed(0);
   instruments.heading = trueHeading.toFixed(0);

   // Instrument lag during high G-forces
   var accelG = Math.sqrt(aircraft.vel.x*aircraft.vel.x + aircraft.vel.y*aircraft.vel.y + aircraft.vel.z*aircraft.vel.z)/gravity;
   instruments.highG = accelG > 3;
   if(instruments.highG){
      instruments.speedLag = instructorsLag(instruments.speedLag, instruments.speed, 0.2);
      instruments.altLag   = instructorsLag(instruments.altLag,   instruments.alt,   0.2);
      instruments.headingLag = instructorsLag(instruments.headingLag,instruments.heading,0.2);
   } else {
      instruments.speedLag = instruments.speed;
      instruments.altLag   = instruments.alt;
      instruments.headingLag = instruments.heading;
   }

   // Altimeter stickiness at 5000-6000 ft
   if(trueAlt>5000 && trueAlt<6000){
      instruments.altStick = true;
      // lock onto last reading for a short time
      if(instruments.altStickCounter===undefined) instruments.altStickCounter=0;
      if(instruments.altStickCounter<120){
         instruments.alt = instruments.alt;
         instruments.altStickCounter++;
      } else {
         instruments.alt = trueAlt.toFixed(0);
         instruments.altStickCounter=0;
      }
   } else {
      instruments.altStick=false;
      instruments.alt = trueAlt.toFixed(0);
      instruments.altStickCounter=0;
   }

   // Compass deviation near magnetic anomalies at heading ~90°
   if(Math.abs((trueHeading-90)%360) < 5){
      instruments.compassError=true;
      instruments.headingLag = trueHeading + (Math.random()<0.5? -10 : 10);
   } else {
      instruments.compassError=false;
   }

   // Render
   render();

   requestAnimationFrame(simulate);
}

function instructorsLag(dest, src, rate){
   // dest moves towards src at given rate
   var val=parseFloat(dest) || 0;
   var tgt=parseFloat(src) || 0;
   return (val + (tgt-val)*rate).toFixed(0);
}

function render(){
   // Clear
   ctx.clearRect(0,0,width,height);

   // Simple horizon: draw line at middle - pitch affects vertical offset
   var horizonY = height/2 - aircraft.pitch*height/4;
   ctx.beginPath();
   ctx.moveTo(0,horizonY);
   ctx.lineTo(width,horizonY);
   ctx.strokeStyle="white";
   ctx.lineWidth=2;
   ctx.stroke();

   // Terrain: simple gray background
   ctx.fillStyle="darkgreen";
   ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height/2);
   ctx.fillStyle="sienna";
   ctx.fillRect(0,height/2,width,height/2);

   // Simple windmill to show roll
   ctx.save();
   ctx.translate(width/2, height/2);
   ctx.rotate(aircraft.roll);
   ctx.fillStyle="gray";
   ctx.fillRect(-5,-pad-5,10,10);
   ctx.restore();

   // HUD
   ctx.fillStyle="rgba(0,0,0,0.5)";
   ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,50);
   ctx.fillStyle="lime";
   ctx.font="16px monospace";
   // speed
   ctx.fillText("SPD:" + (instruments.highG ? instruments.speedLag : instruments.speed)+" KT",10,25);
   // altitude
   ctx.fillText("ALT:" + (instruments.altStick ? instruments.alt : instruments.altLag)+" FT",120,25);
   // heading
   ctx.fillText("HDG:" + (instruments.compassError ? instruments.headingLag : instruments.heading)+"°",240,25);
   // fuel
   ctx.fillText("FUEL:" + instruments.fuel+" %",360,25);

   // Visual indicators for bugs
   if(instruments.highG){
      ctx.fillStyle="red";
      ctx.font="12px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(">>> HIGH G", 10,45);
   }
   if(instruments.altStick){
      ctx.fillStyle="yellow";
      ctx.font="12px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(">>> ALT STICK", 120,45);
   }
   if(instruments.compassError){
      ctx.fillStyle="magenta";
      ctx.font="12px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(">>> COMPASS ERROR", 240,45);
   }
   if(instruments.engineFluct){
      ctx.fillStyle="orange";
      ctx.font="12px sans-serif";
      ctx.fillText(">>> ENGINE FLUCT", 360,45);
   }

   // Simple engine thrust bar
   var thrustBarHeight=height/2;
   ctx.fillStyle="black";
   ctx.fillRect(width-20, height - thrustBarHeight, 15, thrustBarHeight);
   ctx.fillStyle="red";
   var thrustPercent=aircraft.throttle;
   ctx.fillRect(width-20, height - thrustBarHeight + (1-thrustPercent)*thrustBarHeight, 15, thrustPercent*thrustBarHeight);
}

simulate();
}
</script>
